name: pf2-party-codex
description: Archive-first TTRPG campaign workspace with MongoDB source of truth, GM/Player portals, and invitation-based campaign access.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build:target: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace packages/config && npm run build --workspace apps/worker && npm run build --workspace apps/discord-bot && npm run build --workspace apps/foundry-module && npm run build --workspace apps/web-next
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck:target: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace packages/config && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/discord-bot && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/foundry-module && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web-next
scripts.test: node --test tests/route-contracts.test.mjs tests/server-smoke.test.mjs tests/content-contracts.test.mjs tests/demo-seed-contracts.test.mjs tests/demo-targeting-contracts.test.mjs tests/dice-roll-contracts.test.mjs tests/character-editor-contracts.test.mjs tests/character-assignment-contracts.test.mjs tests/pf2-tactical-sheet-contracts.test.mjs tests/pf2-import-enrichment-contracts.test.mjs tests/password-recovery-contracts.test.mjs tests/auth-continuity-contracts.test.mjs tests/invitation-auth-return-contracts.test.mjs tests/invitation-trust-flow-contracts.test.mjs tests/invitation-operations-contracts.test.mjs tests/membership-management-contracts.test.mjs tests/player-management-ui-contracts.test.mjs tests/profile-preferences-contracts.test.mjs tests/campaign-context-resilience-contracts.test.mjs tests/portal-home-contracts.test.mjs tests/route-state-polish-contracts.test.mjs tests/select-archive-hotfix-contracts.test.mjs tests/security/security-foundation.test.mjs
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build:target && npm run test:workspace:runtime
scripts.lint: biome lint apps/web-next apps/worker apps/discord-bot apps/foundry-module packages/config tests/workspace
scripts.format: biome format --write apps/web-next apps/worker apps/discord-bot apps/foundry-module packages/config tests/workspace biome.json docs/architecture/STRICT_TYPESCRIPT_WORKSPACE.md
scripts.format:check: biome format apps/web-next apps/worker apps/discord-bot apps/foundry-module packages/config tests/workspace biome.json docs/architecture/STRICT_TYPESCRIPT_WORKSPACE.md
scripts.check:syntax: find apps/server/src apps/server/scripts scripts tests -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.verify:target: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck:target && npm run build:target && npm run test:workspace:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run verify:target && npm run typecheck && npm run test:contracts && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:syntax && npm run audit:production
